=== HINT 2: Using super().__init__() ===

THE KEY CONCEPT:
When a child class inherits from a parent, it needs to CALL the 
parent's __init__ to set up the inherited attributes.

THE CORE STEP:
  Call the parent constructor using super(), passing the name.

This calls Player's __init__, which sets up:
  - self.name
  - self.health = 100
  - self.max_health = 100
  - self.armour = 2
  - self.accuracy = 85

THEN YOU OVERRIDE THE DIFFERENCES:
  - After super(), replace the stats with Brute or Scout values

BRUTE STATS:
  - health: 120
  - max_health: 120
  - armour: 3
  - accuracy: 70

SCOUT STATS:
  - health: 80
  - max_health: 80
  - armour: 1
  - accuracy: 95

ALSO ADD:
  - describe_specialty(): return a short sentence about the class

Still stuck? Read hint_3.txt
